dependencies.@expo-google-fonts/fraunces: Bundled font; UI only, no data collection
dependencies.@expo/vector-icons: Bundled icons; UI only, no data collection
dependencies.@hookform/resolvers: Form validation; UI only, no data collection
dependencies.@react-native-async-storage/async-storag: On-device storage (session, settings); nothing leaves the phone
dependencies.@sentry/react-native: Crash logs + diagnostics + user ID + install ID -> Data safety: Crash logs, Diagnostics, App interactions, User IDs, Device IDs (Analytics). Service provider, not shared
dependencies.@supabase/supabase-js: Backend (auth, database, storage, functions) over HTTPS; holds all collected data. Service provider
dependencies.@tanstack/react-query: Data fetching cache; UI only, no data collection
dependencies.date-fns: Date formatting; UI only, no data collection
dependencies.expo-apple-authentication: Sign in with Apple -> account creation: OAuth
dependencies.expo-asset: Bundled assets; UI only, no data collection
dependencies.expo-constants: App config; UI only, no data collection
dependencies.expo-crypto: Nonce for Apple sign-in; on device
dependencies.expo-font: Font loading; UI only, no data collection
dependencies.expo-image-manipulator: Resizes photos on device before upload
dependencies.expo-image-picker: Profile photos (images only; microphonePermission false) -> Data safety: Photos. CAMERA permission
dependencies.expo-linking: Deep links; UI only, no data collection
dependencies.expo-localization: Device language for the UI; not sent
dependencies.expo-location: GPS for distance filter, on device only -> precise location NOT collected. Typed addresses geocoded by the OS
dependencies.expo-notifications: Push token stored in Supabase -> Device or other IDs (App functionality). Adds launcher badge permissions
dependencies.expo-router: Navigation; UI only, no data collection
dependencies.expo-sms: Opens Messages with safety text; the user sends it. App reads/sends no SMS -> SMS not collected
dependencies.expo-web-browser: Opens Google sign-in and Stripe Identity in a browser; the app records nothing from them
dependencies.i18next: Translations; UI only, no data collection
dependencies.nativewind: Styling; UI only, no data collection
dependencies.react-hook-form: Forms; UI only, no data collection
dependencies.react-i18next: Translations; UI only, no data collection
dependencies.react-native-purchases: RevenueCat: Plus purchases + app user ID -> Purchase history, Device or other IDs. No ad ID (no play-services-ads-identifier). BILLING + install referrer permissions
dependencies.react-native-url-polyfill: URL support for supabase-js; UI only, no data collection
dependencies.react-native-web: Web build; UI only, no data collection
dependencies.react-native-webview: Embedded web content (Turnstile captcha); no data collection by the app
dependencies.zod: Validation; UI only, no data collection
dependencies.zustand: In-memory state; UI only, no data collection
